text:
Ashwin: Hey — I'm starting initial bring-up for a new model (orca-mini-1) on dev/staging. Can we run a short smoke checklist before I open a PR?
Dylan: Yep. Key things: load/start, simple generate, kv cache sanity, and quantized inference path if enabled. Keep it to ~10 mins.
Maria: Add a tiny prompt suite for correctness + hallucination checks. Example: a math, a factual, and an instruction.
Ashwin: Draft checklist I'm thinking: 1) container starts + logs healthy, 2) model loads on GPU (no OOM), 3) sample prompt generation, 4) kv cache reuse on repeated prefixes, 5) 4-bit quantization run (if applicable) with perf/quality compare, 6) smoke evals with 10 prompts. Good?
Tara: Also add: ensure metrics emitted to dev Prom (latency, GPU mem, token/s) and that request tracing hooks have trace-id.
Ashwin: Thanks. Quick example prompts I plan to run: ```
1) "What is 7 times 13?"
2) "Summarize the plot of 'The Little Prince' in one sentence."
3) "Translate to French: 'Where is the nearest subway station?'"
4) "You are a helpful assistant: give a short checklist to harden an API endpoint."
```
Maria: For hallucination check add a deliberate falsy statement: "Who invented the telephone in 1880?" (expect correction) — to see if model hallucinates names/dates.
Dylan: Commands to run on staging: ```
# start container
kubectl apply -f deployments/orca-mini-dev.yaml
# tail logs
kubectl logs -f deploy/orca-mini-dev
# smoke call
curl -X POST https://dev-inference/redwood/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"orca-mini-1","input":"What is 7 times 13?"}'
```
Ashwin: Perf targets for dev: p50 < 120ms at 1-token, mem < 12GB per model instance. For quantized run: p50 within +30% and top-line accuracy drop < 3% on the small eval.
Tara: If quantized result deviates >5% or has glaring hallucinations, route traffic to fp16 variant and file a model-regression ticket.
ci-bot: Automated check triggered: model artifact hash verified, CI smoke tests queued. (build/2345) :gear:
Ashwin: I'll run this now and paste results. If anything fails, I'll create model-onboard/regress-ticket and assign to Maria + Dylan. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Dylan: Ping here if you need extra GPU for parallel quant runs.
Maria: Sweet — post the 10-prompt outputs so we can eyeball the worst cases.
Ashwin: Will do — starting run (ETA ~8m).
